2  JUDGMENT Heard Sri.Gurudev I Gachchinamath, Miss.Anusha V.Sangami for Sri.S.K.Kayakmath and Sri.B.V.Somapura.
2. Unsuccessful claimant is in appeal challenging the validity of the judgment and award passed in MVC No.2704/2009 on the file of Fast Track Court -II and Addl. MACT, Belgavi dated 31.10.2012 3.

Facts in brief for disposal of the appeal are as under:
3.1

In respect of a road traffic accident that occurred on 27.06.2009 at 1.00 p.m.
when the petitioner was traveling in tum tum rickshaw bearing No.KA-24/3116 met with an accident involving motorcycle bearing No.KA-22/L-3197 ridden by the Sri.Balaram, the petitioner and other inmates of the tum tum rickshaw suffered injuries and they were shifted to hospital at Ramdurga and again for higher treatment Ganga Surgical and Fracture Clinic Hospial, Gokak .

entities.text: Ganga Surgical and Fracture Clinic Hospial, Gokak
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: NC: 2024:KHC-D:3702 3.2 Claim petition was resisted by filing necessary written statement .

3.3 Tribunal after raising necessary issues took into consideration that the 'B' final report came to be filed and there was charge sheet filed against the rider of the motorcycle and the same was suppressed by claimant .As such, dismissed the claim petition.
4.
Being aggrieved by the same, claimant is in appeal.

5. Sri.G.I.Gachchinamath reiterating the grounds urged in the appeal memorandum contended that the insurance company has satisfied the claim in respect of other claimants who are also injured in the same incident and therefore, dismissal of the claim petition by the tribunal in the present case has resulted in gross injustice and sought for allowing the appeal.

6. Per contra, Miss.Anusha Sangami and Sri.B.V.Somapur supported the impugnted judgment NC:
2024:KHC-D:3702 stating that trial judge has rightly considered the material evidence and dismissed the claim petition.
7. Having heard the parties in detail, this court has perused the material on record meticulously.

8. On such perusal of the material on record, accident is occurred on 27.06.2009 at about 01 p.m.
involving tum tum rickshaw bearing No.KA-24/3116 and motorcycle bearing No.KA-22/L-3197 stands established by placing necessary oral and documentary evidence on record.
9.
In respect of other injured persons, insurance company has already satisfied the claim.
At that juncture, the material evidence placed on record was properly appreciated by the tribunal.

10. A different yardstick cannot be applied in respect of the present claimant who is also injured in Tammannappa S/O Maningappa Jamdar vs Gangappa S/O Balappa Madamgiri on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149906670/
3

entities.text: Tammannappa S/O Maningappa Jamdar vs Gangappa S/O Balappa Madamgiri on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: the same accident.
11. Therefore, necessity has arisen to satisfy the impugned judgment and allow the claim petition.
This would take us to the next question what is the quantum of compensation.
According to the claimant, he has suffered injuries as is mentioned in the wound certificate marked at Ex.P.13.
There is a fracture injury as is found form the Ex.P.13 disability certificate mared at Ex.P.20.
PW.2 doctor Wali is not a treated doctor.
This court cannot accept the disability factor mentioned in the Ex.P.20 in toto.
In such circumstances 1/3 of disability is to be taken.

13. The incident has occurred in the year 2009 and in the absence of proper proof of income,
monthly income is to be assessed in a sum of Rs.5,000/-.
Injured was aged 20 years.

Therefore,
appropriate multiplier would be 18.

Accordingly, claimant is entitled for the compensation as under:
Sl. Name of heads Amount(Rs.)
No.
1 Pain and suffering 30,000-00 2
Loss of amenities 20,000-00 3 Food and conveyance charge 10,000-00 4 Loss of income during laid up period 15,000-00
The offending vehicle was duly insured as on the date of accident and therefore, insurance company is liable to pay the compensation.

15. Accordingly, the following:
ORDER i) Appeal is allowed.
 ii) Impugned judgment and award  passed in MVC No.2704/2009 is set  aside.
